content2.content: When `GestureDetector` isn't enough, `RawGestureDetector` gives you access to the gesture arena, allowing you to define custom gesture recognizers.

content4.content: Flutter uses an arena to decide which gesture wins when multiple are competing (e.g., vertical scroll vs. horizontal swipe).

content7.content: This is advanced territory. Only use it if you need to resolve gesture conflicts manually.
